commands: prettier --write . --ignore-path .prettierignore --ignore-unknown
nx run-many -t lint-fix -p analyzer ingestor query-service py-common --parallel
nx run-many -t format -p analyzer ingestor query-service py-common --parallel

python tools/check_result.py init --increment {args.increment} --require test/tools-tests --require test/platform-tests --require test/analyzer-tests --require test/ingestor-tests --require test/query-service-tests --require test/omni-console-tests --require test/py-common-tests --require test/contracts-tests --require integration/ingestor-integration
python tools/check_result.py run --increment {args.increment} --kind test --name tools-tests -- python -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p "test_*.py"
python tools/check_result.py run --increment {args.increment} --kind test --name platform-tests -- nx run platform:test
python tools/check_result.py run --increment {args.increment} --kind test --name analyzer-tests -- nx run analyzer:test
python tools/check_result.py run --increment {args.increment} --kind test --name ingestor-tests -- nx run ingestor:test
python tools/check_result.py run --increment {args.increment} --kind test --name query-service-tests -- nx run query-service:test
python tools/check_result.py run --increment {args.increment} --kind test --name omni-console-tests -- nx run omni-console:test
python tools/check_result.py run --increment {args.increment} --kind test --name py-common-tests -- nx run py-common:test
python tools/check_result.py run --increment {args.increment} --kind test --name contracts-tests -- nx run contracts:test
python tools/check_result.py run --increment {args.increment} --kind integration --name ingestor-integration -- nx run ingestor:test-integration
python tools/check_result.py conclusion --increment {args.increment}

options.command: concurrently --names "PLATFORM,ANALYZER,INGESTOR,QUERY,CONSOLE" --prefix "[{name}]" --prefix-colors "blue,green,magenta,cyan,yellow" "nx run platform:serve --configuration=dev" "nx run analyzer:serve-hmr -- --port 8000" "nx run ingestor:serve-hmr -- --port 8001" "nx run query-service:serve-hmr -- --port 8002" "nx run omni-console:serve -- --port 5173"
